run_test_all_algos: run pytest to test all registered algorithms against the MeltingPot Commons Harvest Open task
run_test_all_tasks: run pytest to test MASAC algorithm across 10 unique MeltingPot environment tasks
run_test_lstm: run pytest to test LSTM sequence models with MAPPO on the MeltingPot COINS task
run_test_reloading_trainer: run pytest to verify experiment checkpoint loading and reloading for all algorithms
run_test_share_policy_params: run pytest to test shared and unshared policy parameters across QMIX, IPPO, and MASAC
